e7_s4_rationale: The presence of multiple nodules in a linear distribution, following the course of branches of the common plantar digital nerves, and the characteristic 'mouse-tail' extension of high signal from one lesion on MRI are highly suggestive of plexiform schwannoma.

e7_s4_rejected.label: glomus tumor
e7_s4_rejected.why: Glomus tumors are typically solitary, painful, and located under the nail, which does not match the presentation of multiple nodules in the plantar aspect of the foot.

e7_s4_rejected.label: neurofibroma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Neurofibromas can be multiple, but they are often associated with neurofibromatosis type 1, and the patient denied any family history of this condition.

e7_s4_rejected.label: schwannoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Schwannomas are typically solitary and do not have the characteristic plexiform morphology seen in this case.

e7_s4_rejected.label: neurilemmoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Neurilemmoma is another term for schwannoma, and the same reasoning for rejecting schwannoma applies to neurilemmoma.
